SELECT * FROM tb_ship WHERE status = 'AVAILABLE' ORDER BY rating DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_ship SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{shipId}
UPDATE tb_ship SET rating = #{rating}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{shipId}
